chunks: Whatever is in this book from Isma'il ibn 'Isa, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil—may Allah be pleased with him—who said: 'Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, from his father, from Isma'il ibn 'Isa.

key_terms.أَبِيهِ: His father; identifies the intermediary narrator in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.الْمُتَوَكِّلِ: A family name within the narrator identification given in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.حَدَّثَنَا: He narrated to us; a technical transmission term in hadith chains.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct reporting by the compiler through a stated chain.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Isma'il ibn 'Isa in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Isma'il ibn 'Isa in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. Its significance is bibliographical and hadith-related, documenting the route of transmission rather than conveying a legal or theological teaching.
